metadata.title: Minimal quasisections of circle bundles
metadata.abstract: Let $E\xrightarrow{\pi}B$ be an oriented circle bundle over an oriented closed surface, and let $\mathcal E$ denote its Euler number. A \textit{quasisection} is a smooth surface $Q$, possibly with boundary, together with a generic smooth map $q:Q\to E$ such that $\pi\circ q(Q)=B$. The \textit{local formula} expresses the Euler number $\mathcal E$ of a bundle as a sum of the weights of the \textit{singular vertices} of a quasisection. In the present paper determine the minimal number $\mathcal N$ of singular vertices for closed and for bordered quasisections for a given circle bundle. For bordered quasisections, \[ \mathcal N_{\mathrm b}(E\to B) =\left\lceil\frac{3|\mathcal E|}{2}\right\rceil. \] For closed quasisections, If $\mathcal{E}$ is even, \[ \mathcal N_{\mathrm cl}(E\to B) =\frac{3|\mathcal E|}{2}. \] If $\mathcal{E}$ is odd, \[ \mathcal N_{\mathrm cl}(E\to B) =4|\mathcal E|. \] We also provide examples of quasisections that realize these minimal values.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 圆丛拟截面的最小奇点数
analysis.workSummary: 对定向闭曲面上的定向圆丛，Euler数记为E，作者精确确定拟截面的最少奇异顶点数：带边界者为ceil(3|E|/2)；闭拟截面在E偶数时为3|E|/2，奇数时为4|E|，并构造达到各下界的例子。
analysis.breakthrough: 把Euler类的拓扑信息转为可达到的奇点计数，并揭示闭拟截面的奇偶效应。
analysis.limitations: 拟截面是可能带边界曲面到总空间的generic映射且投影满射，不是无奇点真截面；两类最小值及Euler奇偶不可混淆。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。第12页明确研究完成未用AI，属于否定声明。12页PDF完整提取、无短文本页，补检未发现其他正向使用声明。
